title: One-on-None Full-Speed Layup
description: A single player sprints the length of the court and finishes at full speed with no defender, purely building transition conditioning and composure.

content.objective: Finish cleanly at full speed after a full-court sprint, with no defender to react to yet.
content.setup: Players start under one basket with a ball and sprint the length of the floor.
instructions: Push the ball ahead with speed dribbles down the sideline.
Attack the rim with controlled speed over the final few steps.
Finish with the correct footwork despite the fatigue of a full sprint.
Jog back and repeat, alternating which hand leads the dribble.
coachingPoints: Keep the head up to see the whole floor while sprinting.
Gather with good footwork even when breathing hard.
Protect the ball on the outside hand away from the sideline.
commonMistakes: Losing control of the dribble by pushing it too far ahead.
Rushing the finish instead of gathering properly.
Bunching into the same lane instead of spreading the floor.
content.safety: Make sure the full length of the court is clear before sprinting.
